description: Frontend issue patterns for JavaFX App.java analysis

patterns.name: UI Thread Blocking - Database Call
patterns.description: Database method call in UI event handler without Platform.runLater()
patterns.fix_suggestion: Wrap database calls in Platform.runLater(() -> { ... }) or execute on background thread with Task/Service

patterns.name: Absolute File Path
patterns.description: Hardcoded absolute file path breaks portability
patterns.fix_suggestion: Use getClass().getResource() for classpath resources or relative paths with Path.of()

patterns.name: Missing Form Clear After Submit
patterns.description: Form fields not cleared after successful submission
patterns.fix_suggestion: Clear all form fields after successful database operation

patterns.name: Orphaned Event Handler
patterns.description: Button or control with setOnAction but handler method not implemented
patterns.fix_suggestion: Implement the referenced event handler method or remove the setOnAction call

patterns.name: Missing UI Refresh After Data Change
patterns.description: Data modification without corresponding UI refresh
patterns.fix_suggestion: Call table.refresh() or reload data after database modifications

patterns.name: Incorrect State Management
patterns.description: UI element state not properly managed (enabled/disabled)
patterns.fix_suggestion: Ensure UI elements are re-enabled after operations complete

patterns.name: Empty Table Data Binding
patterns.description: TableView with no data binding or empty observable list
patterns.fix_suggestion: Set items and configure cell value factories for all columns

patterns.name: Missing Navigation Indicator Update
patterns.description: Navigation action without updating active indicator
patterns.fix_suggestion: Update navigation indicators when switching views

patterns.name: Modal Dialog Not Closing
patterns.description: Dialog or modal window without close/hide call
patterns.fix_suggestion: Ensure dialogs are properly closed after user interaction

patterns.name: Search Filter Not Applied
patterns.description: Search field without filter implementation
patterns.fix_suggestion: Implement filtering logic for search fields

patterns.name: Pagination Display Incorrect
patterns.description: Pagination control without proper page count or index update
patterns.fix_suggestion: Set page count and implement page factory for pagination

patterns.name: Missing Sort Functionality
patterns.description: TableColumn without sort capability
patterns.fix_suggestion: Enable sorting on table columns

patterns.name: Silent Export Failure
patterns.description: Export operation without error handling or user feedback
patterns.fix_suggestion: Add try-catch and show success/error alerts for export operations

patterns.name: Broken Image Display
patterns.description: Image loading without error handling or default image
patterns.fix_suggestion: Check for image load errors and provide default image

patterns.name: QR Code Generation Failure
patterns.description: QR code generation without error handling
patterns.fix_suggestion: Add error handling for QR code generation

patterns.name: Toast Notification Stacking
patterns.description: Multiple toast notifications without queue management
patterns.fix_suggestion: Implement notification queue to prevent stacking

patterns.name: Incomplete Theme Application
patterns.description: Theme switching without applying to all components
patterns.fix_suggestion: Apply theme to all scenes and dialogs

patterns.name: Responsive Layout Issue
patterns.description: Fixed size components that don't adapt to window resize
patterns.fix_suggestion: Use layout constraints and grow priorities for responsive design

patterns.name: Missing Accessibility Labels
patterns.description: UI controls without accessibility labels or tooltips
patterns.fix_suggestion: Add tooltips and accessibility text to all interactive controls
patterns.example_correct:
button.setTooltip(new Tooltip("Click to submit"));
button.setAccessibleText("Submit button");

patterns.name: Missing Keyboard Navigation
patterns.description: Interactive elements without keyboard event handlers
patterns.fix_suggestion: Add keyboard event handlers for accessibility

patterns.name: Duplicate List Entries
patterns.description: Adding items to list without duplicate check
patterns.fix_suggestion: Check for duplicates before adding to collections
